When playing this game, the strategy is to notice which gnomes collect more mushrooms compared to the other gnomes. So try to learn the pattern of which ones can collect more mushrooms. I noticed that there were certain gnomes that collect more than others.
Press the s key for left and the k key for right. Press the space bar when the basket appears to collect the mushrooms. 
If you are too slow you will miss the round.
